pull.title: KAFKA-14905: Reduce flakiness in MM2 ForwardingAdmin test due to admin timeouts
pull.body:
This fixes test failures introduced in KIP-894 #13373

In CI these tests are exceeding the 1-second flat timeout defined in the FakeForwardingAdmin, while they very frequently pass locally.

The reason that these tests regressed with the particular PR is that it changed MM2 from using the deprecated alterConfigs method to the incrementalAlterConfigs method, which is not intercepted by the FakeForwardingAdmin. The config sync is a repeated operation, and these repeats made it more likely that at least one of the operations would complete in under 1-second, causing the test to pass. Without the regular configSync call, the tests would fail when the topic creation exceeded the timeout, which was very likely.

Without the 1-second timeout, and without intercepting incrementalAlterConfigs method, the successful topic creation should be sufficient to pass all of these tests. This does mean that the test names are not accurate, and this will be addressed in a follow-up.
